document.common.source_title: Fine mapping of qPH7.1, a QTL for plant height in a synthetic rice population

fields.agent.finding_text: qPH7.1 explained 23.5% of the phenotypic variance and was significantly associated with plant height in both environments.

evidence.quote: qPH7.1 explained 23.5% of the phenotypic variance and was significantly associated with plant height in both environments.

fields.agent.finding_text: We identified a major QTL, qPH7.1, on chromosome 7 using 180 recombinant inbred lines.

evidence.quote: We identified a major QTL, qPH7.1, on chromosome 7 using 180 recombinant inbred lines.
QTL analysis was performed with QTL IciMapping version 4.2 using inclusive composite interval mapping.
The mean plant height of the population ranged from 85.2 to 132.6 cm.
qPH7.1 was located between markers S7_1203 and S7_1377 with a LOD score of 12.8.

fields.agent.finding_text: The allele from Parent1 increased plant height by 8.6 cm.

evidence.quote: The allele from Parent1 increased plant height by 8.6 cm.

fields.agent.finding_text: qPH7.1 was cloned and encodes a gibberellin oxidase.

evidence.quote: qPH7.1 was cloned and encodes a gibberellin oxidase.

agent.finding_text: qPH7.1 co-localized with a previously reported heading date region, suggesting a possible pleiotropic effect that requires validation.

evidence.quote: qPH7.1 co-localized with a previously reported heading date region, suggesting a possible pleiotropic effect that requires validation.
